author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to make YouTube thumbnails with ChatGPT and create eye-catching thumbnail designs in minutes — no complicated design software required.

In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to create YouTube thumbnails with ChatGPT, refine your designs using simple prompts, edit specific parts of a thumbnail, upload logos and reference images, and brainstorm thumbnail concepts designed around viewer intent.

You’ll learn how to:
   - Create a YouTube thumbnail with ChatGPT
   - Generate thumbnail ideas before designing
   - Change clothing, colors, and design elements
   - Remove unwanted objects from a thumbnail
   - Use logos, screenshots, and reference images
   - Match a thumbnail to a brand’s look and feel
   - Get feedback from ChatGPT on an existing thumbnail

I’ll also share tips for creating better YouTube thumbnails that clearly communicate what your video is about and give viewers a reason to click.

Whether you’re a beginner or just want a faster way to create professional-lookin
title: How to Make YouTube Thumbnails with ChatGPT (Step-by-Step)
